subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result field and server_error retry-before-failover behavior be accepted as the canonical fix after proof and conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but it changes retry/session/message-delivery semantics and a harness-facing result contract, which needs maintainer acceptance beyond automated source review.

options.title: Accept after proof and refresh
options.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof plus conflict resolution, then treat this PR as the canonical fix path if the refreshed diff stays equivalent.

options.title: Consolidate into sibling PR
options.body: Move the accepted code shape and useful tests into another open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 if maintainers prefer that branch.

options.title: Reject this contract shape
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want a new optional attempt-result field and request a different current-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and refresh
recommendation.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof plus conflict resolution, then treat this PR as the canonical fix path if the refreshed diff stays equivalent.
